title: Tenant Operating System Studio Convergence Contracts

phases.objective: Provide a repository-native convergence specification whose package, installation, lifecycle, base Draft portfolio, append-only live delta, Work Map, candidate classification, no-secret, and truthful completion contracts validate from the exact candidate tree without granting runtime mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Spec-local deterministic base and live-delta validators from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The file inventory, JSON/OpenAPI contracts, immutable 34-PR base snapshot, one-entry live delta, current 35-PR total, duplicate identity and feature clusters, delivery trains, candidate convergence, Work Map classification, completion state, and no-secret boundaries pass as structured reports.
steps: Validate the exact manifest inventory and specification-only boundaries.
Validate package, installation, lifecycle, candidate-convergence, base Draft portfolio, live-delta, and OpenAPI contract structure.
Validate the base snapshot classifies 12 primary Draft Specs and 22 related Draft PRs exactly once.
Validate the append-only delta adds PR #4464 without colliding with the base registry and produces 23 related Drafts and 35 current classified Draft PRs.
Validate duplicate numeric identities 011 and 014 plus the duplicate 013 System Tool Catalog feature cluster.
Validate Operation Fabric, Hostinger, System Tool Catalog, and ChatGPT/MCP delivery trains, including PR #4464 as a Hostinger repository-provenance correction.
Validate PR #3922 and PR #4432 detailed extraction into generic substrate and bounded reference packages.
Validate Spec 016 is an external integration surface and PR #4462 is its read-only implementation child without independent authority.
Validate all 19 Work Maps and 16 schema domains have explicit decisions while Spec 015 runtime implementation remains blocked.
Validate completion truthfulness and scan the complete Spec directory for prohibited secret patterns.
assertions: The base report declares ok=true, primary_draft_specs=12, related_open_drafts=22, total_open_drafts_classified=34, mutation_authority_granted=false, runtime_implementation_claimed=false, and secrets_included=false.
The live-delta report declares ok=true, current_total_open_drafts_classified=35, added_pull_requests=[4464], mutation_authority_granted=false, and secrets_included=false.
Numeric Spec numbers are not accepted as unique portfolio authority identities.
PRs #3139, #3145, and #3159 are one unresolved System Tool Catalog feature cluster rather than independent canonical features.
PRs #3922, #4386, and #4432 remain bounded package or service sources, while PRs #2949 and #2950 retain distinct subsystem and application roles.
PR #4460 consumes existing tool, context, capability, operation, package, and readback authorities; PR #4462 stays feature-flagged and read-only.
PR #4464 remains a non-production Hostinger workstream correction and creates no independent authority.
Diverged Draft branches remain reconstruct-on-current-main sources rather than blindly merged canonical Specs.
Specification completion cannot be interpreted as runtime, migration, provider, deployment, or Production completion.

phases.objective: Implement package/component registries, deterministic installation compilation, custom entities, lifecycles, forms, file policies, AI definitions, generated tenant-safe surfaces, and reviewed external projections through bounded child PRs.
blockers: The field-level current-main reuse matrix is not complete.
The package registry mapping and custom entity persistence decisions remain open.
Duplicate numeric Spec 011 and 014 identities require review.
The duplicate System Tool Catalog v2 feature cluster has no selected canonical reconstruction.
Stale completion ledgers, mixed Spec/implementation branches, and related Draft dispositions require reconciliation.
The newly observed Hostinger repository-provenance workstream requires exact-head validation and integration review.
Spec 016 OAuth, tool-catalog, Context Kernel, public endpoint, and Developer mode gates remain open.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Tenant system designer and package reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Create and compile a private tenant package with entities, forms, lifecycle, workflow, file, UI, and acceptance components
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The package validates, installs for an exact Brand in sandbox, produces a deterministic installation revision, and exposes tenant-safe generated or reviewed external surfaces without implicit authority.
steps: Create immutable package and component versions through existing platform authorities.
Compile the exact target installation with lineage, conflicts, revision vector, and deterministic hash.
Run sandbox acceptance and prove UI, form, MCP, resource, and operation authority remains server-enforced.

phases.objective: Prove upgrades, rollback, provider/manual fallback, backup/restore, drift reconciliation, delegation revocation, export, handover continuity, and external integration disable/revocation.
blockers: Operational package and installation runtime is not implemented.
Reference packages, infrastructure services, agency/client delegation, and external integration journeys are not reconstructed.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Agency operator, client owner, integration operator, and release reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Upgrade one client installation with local overrides, simulate dependency degradation, revoke an external connection, and execute a client handover
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Conflicts are explicit, rollback is verified, external and agency delegation is revoked, and the client-owned system continues under client principals.
steps: Run three-way package upgrade and block ambiguous local customization conflicts.
Exercise manual/provider fallback, backup/restore, and prior-revision rollback.
Revoke external and agency access, transfer dependencies, and verify continuity plus former-operator denial.

phases.objective: Run bounded pilots for a freelancer, an agency with two client Brands, a client-owned Tenant, four reference package/service targets, and a read-only ChatGPT/MCP external integration cohort.
blockers: Operational and resilient acceptance suites are incomplete.
Pilot Tenants, Brands, packages, services, external connections, effects, budgets, and stop rules are not approved.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Authorized pilot tenants, client reviewers, ChatGPT Developer mode testers, and platform operators
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Author, install, activate, and operate bounded package installations and approved read-only external tools
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Tenant models and external reads operate with isolation, usable surfaces, health/cost evidence, fallback, rollback, revocation, and handover readiness.
steps: Pilot one freelancer-created system and one agency package installed for two isolated client Brands.
Pilot a client-owned Tenant with delegated agency access and tested revocation.
Run the four reference targets under package-specific gates.
Connect the approved read-only MCP surface in Developer mode and verify scoped discovery, denial, bounded output, disable, and revocation.

phases.objective: Verify governed migrations, Production runtime, package/generated/external-surface parity, health, isolation, backup/restore, rollback, support, handover, and truthful closeout.
blockers: Canary acceptance and Production release authority do not exist.
No package runtime migration, deployment, public plugin review, Production canary, or post-merge audit has been executed.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Promote an exact verified release candidate through governed deployment, migration, and external-integration release paths
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production runs intended package, installation, and reviewed external surface revisions with healthy runtime, isolation, fallback, rollback, revocation, handover continuity, and complete closeout evidence.
steps: Verify exact-head CI, migration evidence, main/Production parity, active package configuration, and reviewed external metadata.
Run bounded Production health, generated/external surface, isolation, fallback, revocation, and rollback readback.
Complete post-merge audit and explicitly classify all remaining work.
